event: Before dawn Callum crouches at a forty-foot Overgrowth tree, its moss pulsing blue-green.
He hates it here: the forest breathes, and the air tastes of copper and chlorophyll.
His Gathering Construct, twenty meters ahead, sweeps moss nineteen minutes off schedule.
North-quadrant yield is down 4.1% in four days; Loop Analysis shows the moss regrows in 4h19m.
With his Engineer's Multitool he offsets the north sweep by nineteen minutes in forty seconds.
Collection rate 94.7%, up from 90.6%. Small optimizations are the only kind that last.
Something rustles in the undergrowth; he leaves along his reflective-tape trail without looking.
Spore wolves and vine constrictors hunt here; he once saw a pack kill a Level 18 Ranger.
Pip pulses a wordless alert at his heart rate. "I know," Callum murmurs. "We're leaving."
Twelve minutes on he crosses into the Rustbelt Flats, the Barrier glowing eight miles north.
He checks the time: 5:47 AM. He has a session to start.
The warehouse is cold before dawn, its Flux Capacitors at their lowest charge.
He settles into his salvaged recliner while the loop hums on three threads.
Compound Growth adds 1% an hour, reset if he moves ten meters, fights, or touches a construct.
He sets his anchor; a ring of blue light marks the ten-meter radius on the floor.
"Forty-eight hours," he tells Pip. "Longest session yet." The session begins at +0%.
Hour four: at the workbench, sixteen inches inside the radius, he builds the Mk.V Sentinel.
Its frame is a FANUC robot arm from a Silverado line, rebuilt with copper Flux conduits.
Level 12-15 zones need conditional logic, where the Grinder's recorded macro would fail.
Script Engine Level 1 gives him five lines; he etches five IF/THEN branches into its crystal brain.
He fits a threat-assessment module cut from a Danger Sense gem bought at the Exchange.
The counter ticks to +5%, then +6%; at hour seven he eats a protein bar without tasting it.
Hour twelve, +12%: 683 Essence, 471 Flux, 34 kills, construct efficiency 95.1%.
The Overgrowth calibration is already compounding, nearly nine percent over the last baseline.
At hour fourteen he sleeps five hours inside the radius; the Substrate counts rest as idle.
Hour twenty-two: he wakes, eats two protein bars, and goes back to the Mk.V.
He fits the Mk.V's own Flux Capacitor, good for eighteen hours, as the bonus reaches +22%.
He reckons 2,100 Essence for the session; Level 13 needs 2,365, so three more sessions like it.
Hour thirty, +30%: the Mk.V is 70% built, and he eats the last protein bar.
Hour thirty-four, +34%: the plating is on, and a full diagnostic runs clean.
The Mk.V reads 75% complete; field testing must wait, and he covers it with a tarp.
Past hour thirty-six the world shrinks to the hum, the counter and his pen.
Hour thirty-seven: Pip flashes three times, sharply, then three times again.
A charge presses on his skin; the moss jars on the sill strobe, and the loop stutters.
His interface dissolves into a fractal of collapsing data, then snaps back around one word.
OBSERVED. It hangs five seconds, folds in on itself, and is gone.
The counter reads +38%; his hidden Recursion stat pulses, and settles higher than before.
He logs a fourth OBSERVED: something looked through the interface at whatever he is.
Always in sustained loops past thirty hours, he notes. The Substrate is checking his work.
He goes back to the session, and does not sleep.
Hour forty-one: a thrum runs through the Barrier, then the Fracture-surge sirens wail.
He is on his feet before the first horn ends, and the anchor shatters.
Compound Growth interrupted at 41:17:33, peak +38%, reset to 0%; the gains are kept.
Holding his empty thermos, he climbs the fire escape to the warehouse roof.
Beyond the Barrier, eight miles off, the Detroit Fracture bleeds violet light.
Monsters pour toward the Barrier in waves: crystal quadrupeds, liquid bipeds, too many joints.
Through Loop Sight he watches the Iron Vanguard meet them in a crescent inside the Barrier.
At its centre burns Drake Morrison, Level 42, carving the wave with his greatsword.
Drake splits a crystal quadruped the size of a pickup from skull to sternum in one cleave.
Twenty minutes from first siren to last kill, and the Barrier holds.
Surges now come every fourteen days, not twenty-one, with monsters up to Level 50.
By his math Barrier costs outrun the zone's Flux income in four months; it fails in five or six.
He writes that nobody in the zone can solve this by fighting: linear cannot outpace exponential.
He respects Drake for doing the hardest version of a needed job, and knows it won't be enough.
The only thing that might scale fast enough is what he is building.
He climbs down; the constructs ran through the alarm, but the bonus is gone.
The report: 2,137 Essence, 1,498 Flux, 103 kills and 87 materials in 41 hours.
The seven lost hours would have added 490 Essence; he files it under acceptable cost.
He notes Drake: Level 42, near the soft cap, and not strong enough in four months.
Every piece feeds every other piece, he writes, if the Substrate keeps rewarding it.
He reactivates Compound Growth at +0%, starting over.
He touches Pip, warm as Flux: "Same thing tomorrow. And the day after." Pip pulses once.
Dawn creeps over the Barrier Zone, and the counter ticks to +1%.
